title: Mutable default argument [] in process_sort_params
detail: The `default_keys` parameter at line 41 has a mutable list default `[]`. Although the list is only read (not mutated) inside the function body, using a mutable default is a well-known Python anti-pattern: if the default is ever mutated in a future refactor, all callers sharing the default will be affected. Replace with `None` and assign an empty list inside the function body.
